Artificial intelligence is transforming how organizations approach problem-solving, decision-making, and innovation—but knowing where AI can create reliable value is just as important as knowing where it cannot.
In this Stanford Online webinar delivered in collaboration with Global Alumni, Professor Michael Bernstein explores the practical realities of AI adoption and the role of human judgment in an increasingly AI-enabled workplace. The session examines how to distinguish between problems AI can solve reliably and those that continue to require human expertise, judgment, and oversight.
